questions.title: Median age of the population in Japan
questions.hint: Half the population is older than the median. It moves slowly and depends mostly on past births.
questions.explanation: It rose to 48 years in 2020, from 21 years in 1950.

source.attribution: UN Population Division, World Population Prospects

questions.title: Share of children who die before age five in the world
questions.hint: Vaccines, clean water, and treatment for diarrheal disease all reach children first.
questions.explanation: It fell to 3.6% in 2023, from 16.6% in 1963.

source.attribution: UN Population Division, World Population Prospects

questions.title: Average number of children per woman in the United States
questions.hint: Think about the post-war baby boom and what followed it.
questions.explanation: It fell to 1.6 in 2020, from 3.7 in 1960.

source.attribution: UN Population Division, World Population Prospects

questions.title: Life expectancy at birth in Russia
questions.hint: Think about what the collapse of the Soviet Union in 1991 did to Russian health.
questions.explanation: It went from 68.3 years in 1960 to a low of 64.0 years in 1995, then ended at 71.2 years in 2020.

source.attribution: UN Population Division, World Population Prospects

questions.title: Annual population growth rate in China
questions.hint: Growth depends on births minus deaths, plus migration. It can be negative.
questions.explanation: It went from 2.0% in 1953 to a high of 3.3% in 1963, then ended at -0.2% in 2023.

source.attribution: UN Population Division, World Population Prospects
